notes.title: Fixing A Bug!
notes.notes:
Hello,

Thank you to everybody who played our game. We are happy that you liked it!

A small update to the game, fixing a bug that caused errors on some devices.

Also, updated some dialogues lines!

We are working hard on the second chapter of the game and on releasing an English version of the game.

Thank you for your patience and your encouragement. We really appreciate it.
